title: Take-up Rate for Adults Following Launch of National Adult Immunisation Schedule
what_it_is: Take-up Rate for Adults Following Launch of National Adult Immunisation Schedule

sections.label: National Adult Immunisation Schedule established
sections.summary: MOH established the National Adult Immunisation Schedule in November 2017 to guide adult vaccinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) established the National Adult Immunisation Schedule (NAIS) in November 2017 to provide guidance on important vaccinations for adults.

sections.label: Adult vaccination data and subsidies
sections.summary: MOH lacks comprehensive data, but MediSave claims rose and subsidies were recommended to boost adult vaccination rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH does not have comprehensive data on the total number of adult Singaporeans who have taken up NAIS recommended vaccinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, based on MediSave claim data, MediSave use for flu vaccination in adults has almost doubled from 39,000 in 2017 to 74,000 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MediSave use for pneumococcal vaccinations increased from 9,000 to 12,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Data from a recent National Population Health Survey indicated that the take-up rate for flu vaccinations in Singaporeans aged 65 and above was about 24%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, the take-up rate of flu vaccinations for persons aged 65 and above in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States is about 70%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In July 2019, the HealthySG Taskforce recommended that to further boost adult vaccination rates, subsidies should be provided to help Singaporeans pay for NAIS recommended vaccinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The subsidies are targeted to be rolled out before end-2020.
